subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the
stimulus: parentheses. 1×5= 5 The (a) ----- (up) ----- trend of our population has been lessened to some extent. On the other hand, the rate of (b) ----- (literate) ----- people has increased. Female education has got popularity. There has been a noticeable change in the (c) ----- (aware) ----- of rural people. The rural people have also now become more (d) ----- (care) ----- about health and hygiene. They have also given up their traditional (e) ----- (hygiene) ----- habit. In the field of hygiene and sanitation, rural people are not now at all indifferent as before.
guide_solution: Adding suffix, prefix or both: (a) upward; (b) illiterate; (c) awareness; (d) careful; (e) hygienic.
